mapper.select: SELECT pw.point_wallet_id AS pointWalletId, pp.point_provider_id AS pointProviderId, pp.point_provider_name AS providerName, pp.point_provider_type AS providerType, pp.logo_image_url AS logoImage, pw.total_point AS totalPoint FROM point_wallet pw JOIN point_provider pp ON pw.point_provider_id = pp.point_provider_id WHERE pw.member_id = #{memberId} AND pp.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY pw.total_point DESC, pp.point_provider_name ASC
